LESSON: CARING FOR ANIMALS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Caring for the
Topic 3.2: Caring for Animals environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Caring for Animals environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recognize signs of 3.2.1 Caring for animals in distress distress
2. Appreciate the need to relieve animals of distress. on animal rights, freedoms and appropriate caring activities to alleviate animal distresses. Core-competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration in group activities Links to PCI’s: ESD: Animal Welfare Education, caring for animals Life skills: Effective communication ;learners identify signs of distress in animals Links to other learning activity areas (s): Religious Studies: appreciating animals as God’s creation 127

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Recognize signs of 3.2.1 Caring for animals in distress distress
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize signs of 3.2.1 Caring for animals in distress distress. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the need to relieve animals of distress. on animal rights, freedoms and appropriate caring activities to alleviate animal distresses. Core-competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration in group activities Links to PCI’s: ESD: Animal Welfare Education, caring for animals Life skills: Effective communication ;learners identify signs of distress in animals Links to other learning activity areas (s): Religious Studies: appreciating animals as God’s creation 127

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Caring for Animals environment.
2. Explain Caring for Animals environment to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Caring for Animals environment.
4. Show that you can: Recognize signs of 3.2.1 Caring for animals in distress distress
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Caring for Animals environment. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Caring for Animals environment important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Recognize signs of 3.2.1 Caring for animals in distress distress
2. Appreciate the need to relieve animals of distress. on animal rights, freedoms and appropriate caring activities to alleviate animal distresses.
